classes.title: Pre-School
classes.heading: Pre-School: Ages 2-3 & Ages 3-4
classes.body: Classes are 30 minutes in length, Parent participation is required in the 2-3 yr old classes. Classes are held in the Circus Pre-School room, with 4-5 students per class.
classes.imageAlt: Pre-school gymnasts and a parent sitting on colorful mats near a play tunnel

classes.title: Pre-School Independent Gymnastics
classes.heading: Pre-School Independent Gymnastics: Ages 4-5.
classes.body: Classes are fully independent, 40-45 minutes in length held in the main gym. Students will use regulation gymnastics equipment.
classes.imageAlt: Young child hanging from a gymnastics bar above colorful mats

classes.title: Gymnastics, Recreational
classes.heading: Gymnastics, Recreational: Ages 4-18

classes.title: Team Gymnastics
classes.heading: Team Gymnastics:
classes.body: XCEL Competitive Gymnastics is offered. Current levels include: Copper, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. XCEL gymnasts practice 2 days per week with practice times ranging from 75-120 minutes depending on XCEL level.

classes.heading: Ninja Warrior
classes.body: This is a fast-moving class that keeps kids moving by working on balance & strength in FUN activities. Circuits to include: trampoline, obstacle courses, bars, and friendly physical challenges.
